## Summary

I have successfully implemented the OOTDay brand theme and styling across the frontend application. Here's what was completed:

### Files Modified and Changes Made:

1. **`app/globals.css`** - Updated global CSS theme variables
   - Replaced purple (#A855F7) with crimson (#C41E3A) throughout
   - Changed background from white to cream (#F5F0EB)
   - Added brand color variables: `--ootday-crimson`, `--ootday-cream`, `--ootday-brown`, `--ootday-gold`
   - Updated OKLCH color space values for primary, accent, and other theme colors
   - Updated onboarding colors to match brand crimson
   - Configured dark mode with appropriate crimson variations
   - Added new color mappings to @theme inline section

2. **`components/ui/button.tsx`** - Updated button component styling
   - Changed primary variant to use crimson background with proper hover states (#A01730, #851429)
   - Updated outline variant with crimson border
   - Updated ghost variant with crimson text
   - Added new `circle` variant for navigation arrows with crimson background
   - Updated rounded corners to `rounded-lg`
   - Maintained 44x44px minimum touch target size

3. **`components/ui/card.tsx`** - Updated card component styling
   - Added new `product` variant with crimson background and white text
   - Added `selected` variant with crimson border for active states
   - Updated CardTitle component to support optional accent color prop
   - Maintained responsive padding and rounded corners

4. **`components/ui/input.tsx`** - Updated input component styling
   - Changed border color to crimson for default variant
   - Updated focus ring to use crimson
   - Changed rounded corners to `rounded-lg`
   - Updated placeholder text color to gray-400
   - Fixed error state references to use `destructive` instead of `error`

5. **`components/chat/ChatMessage.tsx`** - Updated chat message styling
   - User messages now use cream background (#F5F0EB)
   - AI messages use white background with subtle border
   - AI avatar icon uses crimson background (#C41E3A)
   - Updated timestamp colors for better readability

6. **`components/ui/badge.tsx`** - Updated badge component
   - Updated outline variant with crimson border and hover state
   - Primary variant automatically inherits crimson from theme variables

7. **`components/layout/Header.tsx`** - Updated header styling
   - Changed logo icon background from accent to primary (crimson)

8. **`components/layout/BottomNavigation.tsx`** - Updated navigation
   - Changed active state color from accent to primary (crimson)

### Validation Results:

✅ **Build Status**: Successfully compiled without errors
✅ **Component Integration**: All updated components work together cohesively
✅ **Color Consistency**: Crimson (#C41E3A) applied across all primary elements
✅ **Background**: Cream (#F5F0EB) background implemented
✅ **Accessibility**: Minimum 44x44px touch targets maintained
✅ **Dark Mode**: Updated with appropriate contrast ratios
